expand_first_verdict: Decisively does not beat legacy post-recovery COO at matched (rung=300000, K=50000): 103.03 mHa vs 129.01 mHa gain vs Parent. Separately, at H4 N=4 R_sep=1.55 (release/FRASCI/notebooks/data/h4_n4_rsep1.55, not part of the 6-system campaign), the same expand-first module hit a reproducible pathology -- converges cleanly to an unphysical ~-20.5 Ha in TWO independent code paths at that strongly-coupled geometry, ~12-13 Ha below anything physical. Working theory: unconstrained free cross-fragment rotation at very close/strong coupling can drive fragment-local orbitals into near-degeneracy, a basis-collapse artifact the module's only gate (E_after<=E_before) cannot catch. Not promoted into frasci.recovery; stays isolated in _expand_coo_frame_experimental.py.
